description: On-device salon CRM for recall dates, follow-up, Paystack billing, closed-app alerts, and the operator desk.
rules: The client book stays in IndexedDB on this device. Do not add a server store for client names or visit history.
NewRecall is the product brand. The in-app mark is the salon name from Settings (default Your salon).
Follow-up means Contact is not_yet_contacted or contacted_unreachable and Response is not_yet_booked. Recall date does not decide follow-up.
The bell, due today, and overdue use that follow-up status plus recall date today or in the past.
Closed-app push may store only a push subscription and a daily schedule of titles, bodies, timezone, hour, and prefs — never the full client book.
SMS and WhatsApp use DEFAULT_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE in src/lib/messageTemplate.ts. There is no Settings template editor.
Entitlement is an open Paystack subscription. Trial is R1 setup (refunded) then R200 per month ZAR after 30 days.
Test and live Paystack money must never be mixed. Mode follows sk_test_ vs sk_live_.
/admin is a separate operator desk (cookie nr_admin). It is not a salon login and is not linked from the marketing footer.
Admin tenant list and cloud backup/restore stay empty until salon books are stored off-device. Do not invent tenant data.
